Existing calls without the argument must keep working. Add the fee exactly once after existing item prices and discounts. Preserve existing quantities, prices and discounts. Python integers of any size, including 10**30 and 10**400, must work without OverflowError or loss of the item subtotal, including fractional amounts after discounts. For integer fees that would lose precision when added to a float, return an exact rational total; Python's standard-library fractions.Fraction is permitted. Do not approximate such totals with float or round away item amounts. Protected acceptance checks live outside your repository and can only be invoked with run_check.
